extra: Decision 96 is the rule this round exists for. A row is built ONLY on an independent judge's PASS on its new evidence. The judge is a Fable subagent (Agent tool, model fable) given ONLY the standard batch file that `evidence.mjs --judge` writes: never your notes, your report, your description of the fix or a leading prompt. Its verdict file's first line is `judge: Fable, independent subagent`. Run every evidence probe with `NJG_BUILDER=S05-C3` so --collect refuses you as judge. This subagent judge is the one helper allowed (decision 96).

'No change' is not a result. Before any fix, run the row's probe and see it RED (the panel shows the state and the fault). A probe that is not red, or does not reach its state, means the row is not started: fix the probe first, then run red.
Two strikes: a row whose fix fails the independent judge twice stops. Put it in the report's 'For Zafar' list with the sheet path and the two FAIL lines; do not try a third time.

One claim per row: before fixing, split any row whose failing line (in s05-fixround-verdicts.md) names several claims into one row per claim (the next free id in its area, the same Source column, each with its own evidence spec in build/sandbox/data/evidence.json). Never weaken Zafar's words; never remove or replace a mechanic (non-negotiable 2): a claim that needs a mechanic changed goes to 'For Zafar'.

Browser: every run under the lock with your own port: `COOK_TEST_PORT=8893 flock -w 3600 /tmp/njg-browser.lock timeout 1200 node ...` (13-minute chunks; exit 75 = run again with --resume <id>). The 15-minute limit is lifted for this round only for ONE final pass of your mode's gate pages at the end (decision 96); while iterating, run only your rows' probes.
Before each push: `git pull --rebase origin ccr-a7370759-t0lee7` (C3 and D3 push to the same branch; never force-push). Push after every group of rows and at least every 30 minutes.

Nobody can approve permission prompts. Write scratch files with the Write tool and keep Bash to simple single commands (node build/tools/..., flock ... evidence.mjs, git); no heredoc-plus-run compound commands. Don't message the orchestrator with send_message: everything goes in your report, pushed.

Finish line (decision 96): when every row is an independent PASS or on the For Zafar list, write the report table (row, red run, green run, judge verdict line) and stop. Never mark a row built from reading code.
